slides.title: Welcome to the Children's Constitution Club!
slides.tip: Welcome music. Make sure everyone is seated in their groups.

slides.title: Hospital Stories
body: 1) January 2019 — Times of India, Chennai: Even though treatment at government maternity hospitals is free, the staff there demand a minimum bribe of Rs 3,500 to show the baby to the mother.
2) March 17, 2017 — Hindustan Times, Hyderabad: A patient's wife came to the hospital for help because they couldn't afford to pay a bribe for a wheelchair.
S. Raju, in his 40s, was being treated for burn injuries from an electrical accident. Since the attendants demanded Rs 100–200 for a wheelchair, his wife sought help.
slides.tip: Two news-based stories. Show the images below.

slides.title: Group Work
body: The teacher distributes sheets with short stories.
Read them in your groups.
While reading, list the following for each story:
One — the value or quality that the story reflects and that every good person should follow.
Two — the specific action or behaviour that demonstrates that value.
slides.tip: Distribute one sheet of Annexure 3 to each group.

slides.title: Example — Master Change says

items.question: Which value am I not showing?
What positive action would show that value?

slides.transcript: MC gives a traffic-signal example: 'I always get late leaving home for school. To reach on time I sometimes break traffic signals. Which value am I not showing? — Not breaking signals, road awareness. Very good! Now what positive action would show that value? — Following rules, respect for other vehicles.'
kn_script: ನಾನು ಯಾವಾಗಲೂ ಮನೆಯಿಂದ ಶಾಲೆಗೆ ಹೊರಡುವಾಗ ತಡವಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಸಮಯಕ್ಕೆ ಸರಿಯಾಗಿ ತಲುಪಲು, ನಾನು ಅನೇಕ ಬಾರಿ ಟ್ರಾಫಿಕ್ ಸಿಗ್ನಲ್‌ಗಳನ್ನು ಮೀರುತ್ತೇನೆ.
ಇಲ್ಲಿ ಒಬ್ಬ ಉತ್ತಮ ಮನುಷ್ಯನಾಗಿ ನಾನು ಹೊಂದಿರಬೇಕಾದ ಆದರೆ ತೋರುತ್ತಿರದ 'ಮೌಲ್ಯ' ಯಾವುದು?
ತುಂಬಾ ಒಳ್ಳೆಯದು! ಈಗ, ಈ ಕಥೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಆ ಮೌಲ್ಯವನ್ನು ತೋರಿಸುವ ಸಕಾರಾತ್ಮಕ ಕ್ರಮ ಯಾವುದು?
en_script: I always get late leaving home for school. To reach on time, I sometimes break traffic signals.
As a good person, which value should I have but am not showing here?
Very good! Now, what positive action in this story would demonstrate that value?
slides.tip: 2 questions. After each clip, ask children for their answers, then press Next Question.

slides.title: Do Group Work
body: Distribute sheets to the groups.
7-minute timer starts. A warning buzzer will sound when 2 minutes remain.
slides.tip: Distribute Annexure 3 sheets. One different sheet per group. 7-minute timer (keep track of time).

slides.title: Wrap Up Group Work
body: Thank you! You all did very well in your groups!
It's okay if you didn't finish. When we share with each other, all stories/scenarios will be discussed.
Quickly pick two stories/scenarios that you'd like to share with the whole class.
1-minute timer.
slides.tip: 1-minute timer. Each group must pick two stories.

slides.title: Share Stories
body: Turn by turn, one person from your group please read out one of your chosen stories to the class.
Do not repeat stories/scenarios.
slides.tip: Go to each group and ask them to share one story. Maintain discipline.

slides.title: Write on the Board — Group Summary
body: One member from each group, come to the board and write 2 action statements from your list.
You have only 1 minute, so be quick!
Come to any part of the board and write in big letters so everyone can read.
slides.tip: 1-minute timer. Make sure everyone has chalk.

slides.title: Let's Reflect — 2 Minutes of Silence
body: Let us all quietly think for a moment about what emerged from your group discussions and what is written on the board.
You have 2 minutes to think and reflect.
slides.tip: When children start thinking, encourage them to connect the values to the hospital stories from the beginning of the session.

slides.title: Rs 150 — What Would You Do?
slides.tip: Give children time to answer. If they're slow, press REVEAL/NEXT to show 'Choice'.
slides.intro_text: A shopkeeper accidentally gives you Rs 150 extra change — what would you do?
post_video_text: What do we call this act of making a decision?

slides.transcript: Friends, in the hospital stories you read — what choice did poor people have? Sometimes poor people have very few choices. Poor people pay bribes out of compulsion.
slides.title: Think About the Hospital Stories
kn_script: ಸ್ನೇಹಿತರೇ, ಆರಂಭದಲ್ಲಿ ನೀವು ಓದಿದ ಆಸ್ಪತ್ರೆಯ ಕಥೆಗಳಲ್ಲಿ, ಬಡ ಜನರಿಗೆ ಯಾವ ಆಯ್ಕೆ ಇತ್ತು? ಅವರು ಲಂಚ ನೀಡದಿದ್ದರೆ ತೊಂದರೆ ಅನುಭವಿಸಬೇಕಿತ್ತು.
ಬಡ ಜನರಿಗೆ ಕೆಲವೊಮ್ಮೆ ಅತಿ ಕಡಿಮೆ ಆಯ್ಕೆಗಳಿರುತ್ತವೆ. ಬಡವರು ಲಂಚ ಕೊಡುವುದು ಬಲವಂತದಿಂದ.
en_script: Friends, in the hospital stories you read at the beginning — what choice did poor people have? If they didn't pay the bribe, they had to suffer.
Sometimes poor people have very few choices. Poor people pay bribes out of compulsion.
slides.tip: MC draws children's attention to the hospital stories. Give time for discussion.

slides.transcript: In the hospital stories — what do you say about the choices the staff made? They could have chosen not to take bribes from the poor — but they didn't.
slides.title: What About the Hospital Staff's Choices?
kn_script: ಆಸ್ಪತ್ರೆಯ ಕಥೆಗಳಲ್ಲಿ, ಆಸ್ಪತ್ರೆಯ ಸಿಬ್ಬಂದಿ ಮಾಡಿದ ಆಯ್ಕೆಗಳ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಏನು ಹೇಳುತ್ತೀರಿ?
ಅವರು ಬಡವರಿಂದ ಲಂಚ ತೆಗೆದುಕೊಳ್ಳದಿರುವ ಆಯ್ಕೆಯನ್ನು ಮಾಡಬಹುದಿತ್ತು — ಆದರೆ ಮಾಡಲಿಲ್ಲ.
en_script: In the hospital stories, what do you say about the choices the hospital staff made?
They could have chosen not to take bribes from the poor — but they didn't.

slides.title: Behind the Choice — Integrity (INTEGRITY)
body: What quality is missing behind the hospital staff's choice?
slides.tip: After children answer, press REVEAL/NEXT. Creatively reveal 'INTEGRITY'.
post_video_text: Our personal integrity can change thousands of situations like the ones you read about in the stories.

slides.transcript: MC talks about daily choices at school — spoiled Change Champion Box, copying from ChatGPT, helping absent friends, admitting a broken window. Ends with 'your daily choices make you a real change champion'.
slides.title: Everyday Choices
kn_script: ಈಗ ನಾವು ಶಾಲೆಯಲ್ಲಿಯೇ ಮಾಡುವ ಕೆಲವು ಆಯ್ಕೆಗಳ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಮಾತನಾಡೋಣ.
ಕೆಲವು ಮಕ್ಕಳು ಖಾಲಿ ಚೀಟಿಗಳನ್ನು ಹಾಕುತ್ತಿದ್ದಾರೆ ಮತ್ತು Change Champion Box ಅನ್ನು ಹಾಳು ಮಾಡುತ್ತಿದ್ದಾರೆ.
ನಾವು ನಮ್ಮ ಪ್ರಾಜೆಕ್ಟ್ ಕೆಲಸವನ್ನು ಗೂಗಲ್ ಅಥವಾ ChatGPT ನಿಂದ ಕಾಪಿ ಮಾಡಿದರೆ ಮತ್ತು ನಾವೇ ಅದನ್ನು ಮಾಡದಿದ್ದರೆ ಏನಾಗುತ್ತದೆ?
ನಿಮ್ಮ ಸ್ನೇಹಿತರೊಬ್ಬರು ಗೈರುಹಾಜರಾಗಿದ್ದರು ಮತ್ತು ಮರುದಿನ ನೀವು ಅವರಿಗೆ ಪಾಠದಲ್ಲಿ ಸಹಾಯ ಮಾಡುತ್ತೀರಿ.
ಕೆಲವು ಮಕ್ಕಳು ಆಟವಾಡುವಾಗ ಕಿಟಕಿಯ ಗಾಜನ್ನು ಒಡೆದರು ಮತ್ತು ಅವರು ಅದನ್ನು ಶಿಕ್ಷಕರಿಗೆ ಒಪ್ಪಿಕೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತಾರೆ.
ನಿಮ್ಮ ದೈನಂದಿನ ಆಯ್ಕೆಗಳು ನಿಮ್ಮನ್ನು ನಿಜವಾದ ಬದಲಾವಣೆಯ ಶಕ್ತಿಯನ್ನಾಗಿ ಮಾಡುತ್ತವೆ.
en_script: Now let's talk about some choices we make right here at school.
Some children are putting in blank chits and spoiling the Change Champion Box.
What happens if we copy our project work from Google or ChatGPT and don't do it ourselves?
Your friend was absent and the next day you help them with the lesson.
Some children broke a window pane while playing, and they admit it to the teacher.
Your daily choices make you a real change champion.
slides.tip: Give children time to respond after each scenario.

slides.title: Two Sides of a Coin (Optional)
body: Every coin has two sides.
In life too, every matter has more than one perspective.
slides.tip: Show only if time permits. Optional.

slides.title: Start — Stop — Continue
body: Based on what you learned today:
What is one new thing you want to start doing in your life?
What is one thing you want to stop doing?
What is something you're already doing that you want to continue?
slides.tip: Give each child time to share one answer.

slides.transcript: Wow! Our CMCA Club is learning so many new things. Time to collect all the positive changes in our lives. Let me introduce something exciting — the Change Champion Box! It's a box that collects your change stories.
slides.title: Change Champion Box — Introduction
kn_script: ವಾಹ್! ನಮ್ಮ CMCA ಕ್ಲಬ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ನಾವು ಎಷ್ಟು ಹೊಸ ವಿಷಯಗಳನ್ನು ಕಲಿಯುತ್ತಿದ್ದೇವೆ ಮತ್ತು ಅದ್ಭುತವಾದ ಚಟುವಟಿಕೆಗಳನ್ನು ಮಾಡುತ್ತಿದ್ದೇವೆ.
ಈಗ, ನಮ್ಮ ಜೀವನದಲ್ಲಿ ನಡೆಯುತ್ತಿರುವ ಎಲ್ಲಾ ಸಕಾರಾತ್ಮಕ ಬದಲಾವಣೆಗಳನ್ನು ಸಂಗ್ರಹಿಸುವ ಸಮಯ ಬಂದಿದೆ!
ನಾನು ನಿಮಗೆ ಒಂದು ಆಕರ್ಷಕ ವಿಷಯವನ್ನು ಪರಿಚಯಿಸುತ್ತೇನೆ — ಅದೇ Change Champion Box! 🎉
ಇದು ನಿಮ್ಮ ಬದಲಾವಣೆಯ ಕಥೆಗಳನ್ನು ಸಂಗ್ರಹಿಸುವ ಪೆಟ್ಟಿಗೆ.
en_script: Wow! We're learning so many new things and doing amazing activities in our CMCA Club.
Now, it's time to collect all the positive changes happening in our lives!
Let me introduce you to something exciting — the Change Champion Box!
It's a box that collects your change stories.
slides.tip: Check if the change_champion_rules.mp4 video from Session 1 can be reused. If not, a new video is needed.
